items.title: Adobe Breach – Threat Actor Allegedly Claims Leak of 13 Million Support Tickets and Employee Records
items.description: A threat actor identified as “Mr. Raccoon” has allegedly breached Adobe, claiming to have exfiltrated a massive trove of sensitive data, including 13 million support tickets containing personal information, 15,000 employee records, all HackerOne bug bounty submissions, and a range of internal documents, according to a report published by International Cyber Digest.
